stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: Can it read while I sell?

stations.title: Hut computer
stations.text: Does one job at a time, the speaker first

stations.title: Your threads
stations.gap: Only one job at a time

captions: Morning at the Lanternquay hut. Bridie wants the announcement read while she sells.
While the speaker reads, the computer does nothing else, and the queue grows.
You give the slow jobs threads of their own, and stop the bell when the hut closes.
The speaker reads, the lists are counted and the bell rings while tickets are sold.
Bridie's queue moves again, and the hut closes on time with the bell quiet.
